payload.prompt: Effectuez la clôture annuelle simplifiée pour 2025 : 1) Calculez et comptabilisez l'amortissement annuel de trois immobilisations : Kontormaskiner (433350 NOK, 3 ans linéaire, compte 1200), IT-utstyr (491450 NOK, 6 ans, compte 1210), Kjøretøy (207050 NOK, 9 ans, compte 1230). Utilisez le compte 6010 pour les charges d'amortissement et 1209 pour les amortissements cumulés. 2) Extournez les charges constatées d'avance (total 63200 NOK au compte 1700). 3) Calculez et comptabilisez la provision d'impôt (22 % du bénéfice imposable) sur compte 8700/2920. Comptabilisez chaque amortissement comme une pièce comptable séparée.

payload.goal: Perform simplified year-end closing for 2025: post three separate depreciation vouchers, reverse prepaid expenses on account 1700, and accrue income tax at 22% of taxable profit using accounts 8700/2920.
likely_resources: general ledger or trial balance report for 2025
year-end closing endpoint or period status endpoint
success_checks: Three separate vouchers exist for 2025 depreciation, one per asset, with correct amounts and specified asset accounts
Depreciation expense is posted to account 6010 and accumulated depreciation to account 1209 as requested
Prepaid expenses reversal of 63200 NOK is posted against account 1700 in 2025
Tax provision voucher is posted using accounts 8700 and 2920
Tax provision amount equals 22% of taxable profit used in the calculation
All vouchers are dated within fiscal year 2025 and balanced
risk_notes: Taxable profit amount is not provided; tax provision cannot be finalized without calculating or retrieving 2025 taxable profit from ledger data
Using one accumulated depreciation account 1209 for assets on 1210 and 1230 may be nonstandard; prompt explicitly requests 1209, but chart-of-accounts validation may differ
Reversal direction for prepaid expenses is not explicitly stated; likely debit expense and credit 1700, but exact expense account is missing
No exact voucher date provided; year-end date likely 2025-12-31
Useful lives are assumed to start with full-year depreciation and no residual value; if acquisition dates or partial-year rules apply, amounts may differ
payload.suggested_first_action: Fetch 2025 trial balance/general ledger to determine taxable profit and confirm account availability before creating year-end vouchers.
ordered_steps: GET accounting year/period status for 2025 and ensure period is open for voucher posting
GET chart of accounts to confirm accounts 1200, 1209, 1210, 1230, 1700, 6010, 8700, 2920 exist and are active
POST voucher dated 2025-12-31 for depreciation of Kontormaskiner: debit 6010 = 144450.00, credit 1209 = 144450.00; include reference to asset account 1200 in description
POST voucher dated 2025-12-31 for depreciation of IT-utstyr: debit 6010 = 81908.33, credit 1209 = 81908.33; include reference to asset account 1210 in description
POST voucher dated 2025-12-31 for depreciation of Kjøretøy: debit 6010 = 23005.56, credit 1209 = 23005.56; include reference to asset account 1230 in description
Determine reversal entry for prepaid expenses total 63200 on account 1700 by retrieving source balance/details for 2025
POST voucher dated 2025-12-31 to reverse prepaid expenses: credit 1700 = 63200.00 and debit the appropriate expense account(s) totaling 63200.00
GET 2025 profit and loss / taxable profit basis from ledger or trial balance
POST voucher dated 2025-12-31 for tax provision: debit 8700 = calculated amount, credit 2920 = calculated amount
GET posted vouchers and verify all year-end entries are balanced and booked in 2025

planned_endpoints.summary: Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.

rules: Use params={"number": XXXX} to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
This is a QUERY PARAM via the params field — NOT json_body.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
POSTING BALANCE RULES (which determines single-leg vs manual-leg):
vatType != 0 (e.g. id=3 for 25%): include ONLY the debit posting with GROSS amount. Tripletex auto-generates VAT + credit.
vatType == 0 (exempt): include BOTH debit AND credit postings manually. They must sum to 0.
If you get 422 'postings don't sum to 0': you used vatType=0 but only one posting. Either add the credit posting manually OR change to the correct vatType (e.g. 3 for 25%).
NEVER default to vatType=0 for standard purchases — use vatType=3 (25%) unless explicitly VAT-exempt.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Resolve account numbers: GET /ledger/account with params={"number": XXXX}, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.

payload.trace_example_task: Year-end closing vouchers. 3-6 API calls. Use account numbers from prompt directly.

payload.question: For year-end closing vouchers in Tripletex sandbox, what is the minimal correct POST /ledger/voucher body shape for manual no-VAT postings (vatType id 0) dated 2025-12-31? Also, for reversing prepaid expenses on account 1700 when no expense account is specified by the prompt, should I use 1700 against 6010 or another standard account, or must I stop? Finally, if taxable profit is not provided in the prompt, should I create only the vouchers that can be computed directly and report the tax provision as blocked, or is there a supported endpoint to derive taxable profit with minimal calls?

payload.headline: All 4 scoring checks failed despite 4 vouchers created; likely wrong account IDs or amounts.
what_went_wrong: All 4 checks failed (score 0.0/8.0), suggesting the vouchers were posted with incorrect account IDs — the agent used a single hardcoded account ID (482475275) for account 6010 without verifying the actual IDs for 1209, 1700, 8700, 2920.

The agent made 6 redundant GET /ledger/account calls but apparently did not correctly map account numbers to their IDs before posting — all postings appear to use the same account ID (482475275) for both debit and credit lines.

The tax provision voucher (22% of taxable profit on accounts 8700/2920) was never posted — the agent incorrectly concluded the taxable profit was not provided, when it should have been derived from the ledger balance.

Kjøretøy depreciation amount 23005.56 NOK (207050/9) is correct mathematically, but IT-utstyr at 81908.33 (491450/6) should be verified — however the core failure is wrong account IDs making all postings invalid.
what_worked: The agent correctly calculated linear depreciation amounts for all three assets.
Four vouchers were successfully created in Tripletex without HTTP errors.
what_to_try_next: After GET /ledger/account, explicitly map each account number (1200, 1209, 1210, 1230, 1700, 6010, 8700, 2920) to its correct ID and use distinct IDs for debit/credit lines in each voucher posting.
Query the ledger balance (GET /ledger/balance or similar) to compute taxable profit before posting the 22% tax provision voucher on accounts 8700/2920.
Reduce redundant GET /ledger/account calls to a single call with appropriate filters, then reuse the results for all subsequent voucher postings.
unnecessary_calls: 5 of the 6 GET /ledger/account calls are redundant — one call with all needed account numbers would suffice.
GET /ledger/account calls returned data but account IDs were not correctly extracted/used, making them effectively wasted.
